1.text: When you receive your paycheck, what is your first instinct?

options.F: Immediately transfer a portion to savings
options.L: Check my wish list and treat myself

2.text: How do you handle grocery shopping?

options.F: I stick to a strict list and look for discounts
options.L: I buy whatever looks good or inspires me

3.text: A new phone model just came out. You...

options.F: Wait until my current one completely dies
options.L: Consider upgrading if it has cool new features

4.text: Your friends invite you to an expensive dinner. You...

options.F: Suggest a cheaper alternative or decline politely
options.L: Go along! Experiences are worth paying for

options.F: A daily ritual I strictly follow
options.L: A vague guideline I try to keep in mind

6.text: If you had $10,000 to invest, where would you put it?

options.C: A high-yield savings account or bonds
options.A: Crypto or a high-growth stock startup

7.text: How do you feel about the stock market crashing?

options.C: Terrified, I might pull my money out

8.text: You hear about a risky investment with potential 10x returns. You...

options.C: Stay away, it sounds like a scam or gamble
options.A: Invest a small amount just to see what happens

9.text: When planning for retirement, you prefer...

options.A: Maximum possible growth, even if risky

10.text: Your financial knowledge mainly comes from...

FC.name: The Guardian
FC.description: You are the bedrock of financial stability. You value security over luxury and prefer steady, predictable growth.
pitfalls: Risk aversion may lead to inflation loss
Can be too frugal to enjoy life
tips: Explore low-cost index funds to beat inflation
Remember that money is a tool, not just a scoreboard

FA.name: The Strategist
FA.description: You are disciplined with spending but bold with investing. You save aggressively to fuel your high-growth ambitions.
pitfalls: Might take uncalculated risks with hard-earned savings
tips: Ensure you have a liquid emergency fund before heavy investing
Balance your portfolio with some stable assets

LC.name: The Enthusiast
LC.description: You love to enjoy the present moment and prefer your investments to be safe and sound. You work hard to spend well.
pitfalls: Financial stress from lack of buffer
tips: Automate savings before you see the money
Use the 50/30/20 rule to structure spending
Find low-cost ways to enjoy your hobbies

LA.name: The Maverick
LA.description: You live fast and invest fast. High earning potential, high spending, and high risk tolerance define your style.
tips: Create a 'do not touch' safety net account
